text:
- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is INR 162.31 billion with a gross margin of 40.2% and EBITDA margin of 16.7%.
- The company that contributes the most to the revenue is Wipro GE Healthcare with INR 97.41 billion, while Wipro Kawasaki Precision Machinery needs attention with a lower gross margin of 36.2% and EBITDA margin of 14.8%.
- Margins for the company are at 40.2% for gross margin and 16.7% for EBITDA margin.
- Working capital as of 2026-07-01 is managed with DSO days at 69 and DPO days at 79.
- Top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding profit centre EQ, revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves with a revenue change of INR 4.08 billion (37.9% of total change), revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves excluding profit centre EQ with a revenue change of INR 2.47 billion (23% of total change), and revenue account Sales - Hydraulic Pumps excluding profit centre EQ with a revenue change of INR 2.05 billion (19.1% of total change).
